title: ECF Layout 12 structural manifest

name.$comment: Espelha (com folga) o IsFieldNameValid do CatalogoBuilder/gerador .NET: primeiro caractere letra ou underscore, demais letra/digito/underscore. Bloqueia espaco, hifen, barra e outros separadores que quebrariam o alias Nome do [CampoSped].

$comment: Canonical code/block/order is encoded by prefixItems. Relational invariants pageEnd >= pageStart and contiguous field numbers are enforced by tooling semantic validation because JSON Schema does not express them directly.
